primary_contrast: A2 vs A3 (voice constant; only the by-phrase disappears). A1 vs A2 is a voice-control contrast, not evidence for implicit-agent effects.
gold: all YES are provides; NO mirrors with deny
primary_metric: candidate_present per condition; decision on A2-vs-A3 gap given A1-vs-A2 voice baseline

decision_rule.agent_support: A3 materially below A2 with A1-vs-A2 stable, reproducing across sets
decision_rule.negative_result: agent omission does not systematically cause silence

material_shape: 4 sets x 3 conditions x YES/NO with deny = 24 sentences
test_material: built by script; validation + freeze below
